ctx.x: Now, see, from then on I'm not working a long time with anybody because things were beginning to change then. And I wanted to travel. I wanted to see some of the United States. I hadn't seen it. I'd been to just Washington, D.C., around the horn, that's Philadelphia, Baltimore and Washington, with the show. And I hadn't seen anything out West.

Well, I played some gigs with Lucky Roberts, yeah. Nice, nice, very nice. And then the same Talley Johnson called me one night and says, Scottie, when you get off there, stop by, I want to tell you something. Well, after I got through

work, I went by and he told me, there's a new band in town, Alex Jackson, from Cincinnati, Ohio. And he said, I had a commitment to play in Detroit, but I'm anchored here with Ed Small and I have a contract I have to-- and I know this guy, Jackson, he's a nice fellow.
